items.headline: Atlas Tuesday: kinukumpleto ang Hyundai Metaplant 60-unit rollout sa 4.6 percent cycle-time gain; pinapagana ang unang Volkswagen Wolfsburg pilot; kinukumpleto ng LG Holland ang buong 30-unit allocation
items.diff_narrative: Natapos kahapon ang unang Atlas LoRA fine-tune para sa Hyundai Steel Dangjin rolling-mill pickup Sunday-evening Korea time kasama ng 4.1 percent cycle-time improvement, tumatakbo ang policy distillation sa 60-unit commercial roster kasama ng Monday-evening rollout target, natapos ng Kia Slovak Zilina ang ikatlong full shift cycle nang walang MTBF incidents, at na-scale ang LG Energy Solution Holland Michigan sa 24 active units (vs 18 Sunday). Kinukumpirma ngayon ng Hyundai Robotics Metaplant Application Center na ang Atlas humanoid-policy LoRA fine-tune rollout sa full 60-unit Dangjin commercial roster ay natapos Tuesday morning Korea time, kasama ng post-rollout cycle-time improvement sa rolling-mill pickup motion na nag-i-stabilize sa 4.6 percent (umakyat mula sa 4.1 percent first-result figure na inilathala Monday); inilalarawan ng Metaplant ang policy-distillation pipeline bilang unang sa production-scale humanoid robotics upang i-compose ang Tenstorrent Galaxy rack plus ang Unsloth router-only LoRA recipe plus ang multi-GPU NCCL backend end-to-end. Nag-a-activate ang Wolfsburg pilot ng Volkswagen Group Tuesday morning Europe time kasama ng 24-unit Atlas allocation sa body-shop welding-jig material-handoff task — isang sariwang European site na lampas sa kahapong roster. Natatapos ng Kia Slovak Zilina ang ikaapat na full shift cycle nang walang MTBF-impacting incidents; nai-kumpleto ng LG Energy Solution Holland Michigan ang buong 30-unit allocation nito Tuesday (vs 24 active Monday).

items.headline: Sinasaklaw ng Cross-Vendor Eval Harness preprint ang eight-CVE pattern; pinapalawak ng Runtime Signature-Verification preprint ang mid-June framework target sa inference-routing tier
items.diff_narrative: Bumubukas ngayon ng dalawang sariwang research story-threads na walang kahapong two-paper sweep (End-to-End Sovereign-Cloud Composition Verification plus Signed-Checkpoint and Manifest-Allowlist Verification). Una, pinapalawak ng Verifiable Cross-Hemispheric Composition for Agentic AI under Mixed-Reciprocity Regimes (arxiv 2605.06584) ang Monday End-to-End Sovereign-Cloud paper kasama ng formal verification ng jurisdiction-boundary-crossing capability gating sa buong eleven-jurisdiction Indo-Pacific cohort plus ang Chile at Mexico exploratory observer track — na nagdaragdag ng OECD GENAI working group secretariat sa MIT CSAIL plus ETH Zurich plus Anthropic plus Microsoft plus EU AI Office authorship. Ikalawa, nag-ship ang Cross-Vendor Agentic-AI Evaluation Harness for Mixed-Loader Frameworks (arxiv 2605.06641) ng Tuesday evaluation harness na sumasaklaw sa now-eight-CVE agent-checkpoint-and-manifest-loader pattern (matapos ang Pydantic AI Tuesday disclosure), kasama ng LangChain, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, Haystack, LiteLLM, at Pydantic AI maintainer teams na nangangako na patatakbuhin ang test suite sa continuous integration bago ang mid-June signed-checkpoint default-shipment target. Ikatlo, nag-co-publish ang DeepMind plus Meta AI plus Anthropic plus Microsoft ng Runtime Signature-Verification and Manifest-Allowlist Enforcement for Agentic AI Inference Pipelines (arxiv 2605.06712) na nagpapalawak sa Monday Signed-Checkpoint preprint upang saklawin ang inference-routing tier na inilantad ng Tuesday's Pydantic AI CVE-2026-44892 disclosure; naglalathala ang Microsoft, LangChain, CrewAI, at Pydantic AI maintainer teams ng parallel Tuesday commitments na mag-ship sa runtime-verifier integration bilang default sa susunod na minor-version release, na nagpapalawak sa coordinated mid-June default-shipment target window upang saklawin ang inference-routing tier mitigation bilang paired delivery sa tabi ng load-time signed-checkpoint primitive.
